name: Jareth Thomas
title: Operations, Warehouse Logistics & Skilled Trades Professional
summary: Operations, manufacturing, warehouse logistics, and skilled trades professional with hands-on experience in order fulfillment, receiving, inventory control, production support, electrical work, and small business ownership. Strong background coordinating teams, managing workflow, supporting customer needs, and troubleshooting technical, equipment, and job-site issues. Focused on safety compliance, productivity, reliable execution, and keeping operations moving in fast-paced environments.

Follow safety procedures and warehouse best practices while navigating pick paths and handling packages throughout each shift.
Coordinate with team members and area leadership to keep outbound workflow moving efficiently during peak volume periods.
